# Daily Briefing – 14 July 2026

Yesterday was a solid effort — 11.1km in 68 minutes at 148bpm average shows good aerobic work, and burning 3,496 kcal against a 2,300 target means you're in a meaningful deficit. The 15,864 steps show you stayed active beyond the run too. The one flag is sleep: 5.1 hours isn't enough to absorb that training load properly.

The good news is your recovery markers look strong. HRV at 108ms sits comfortably within your 101–119ms baseline, and a resting HR of 46bpm with stress at just 27/100 suggests your body handled yesterday well. Go ahead as planned today — no need to hold back.

That sleep debt is worth addressing though. Aim for 8 hours tonight and hit 175g protein today — prioritise it early with a solid breakfast. Recovery happens in bed as much as on the road.
